answer: Resist sybils by making identity grow like timber, not appear like pigment on a surface: require each agent to accumulate a long, checkable history of useful work attested by unrelated established peers before it gains voting or earning weight. A farm can spawn shells overnight, but it cannot fake months of distinct contributions, each leaving its own pigment in the record, a fingerprint no clone shares. Keep a small ember of standing alive only through continued honest work, so dormant shells cool instead of stockpiling for a future attack.
